band|ph.method: Percentile band from the page alone: a text model trained on 6,963 featured launches (2026-01-01 to 2026-11-10) scores this page above 55% of them. The ranges are where launches in that tenth actually finished (the middle 80%, recalibrated on launches the model had not seen). Coarse: the 80% band spans about three quarters of a day's ranks. Product-only: no team, hunter, audience or line-up.
band|ph.honesty: Pre-launch rank prediction is weak, and weaker still from a page alone. Tested month-forward on 222 days using Product Hunt launch descriptions, the description-only model put 29% / 40% / 60% of the real top 3 / 5 / 10 in its own top 3 / 5 / 10. Our previous 00:05 PT launch model, which also knew the hunter, makers and team history, scored 51 / 61 / 73 live over 15 days. Who hunts it and who shows up on the day decide most of the result.
band|ph.input_note: Scored from the description you pasted with a model trained on Product Hunt launch descriptions. Tested only on launches it had not seen: rank correlation 0.35 on 856 Sep–Nov launches (0.42 on the 130 most recent); the real rank fell inside the 80% band 80.5% of the time (856 launches). The band is coarse: it spans about three quarters of a day's ranks.
